name: Pinball Universe VR
summary: Step into Pinball Universe VR — a whole arcade of pinball at your fingertips! Play four original tables, each a fully themed world: Dragon's Treasure Cave, Galaxy Defender Strike, Skull Flower Fiesta, and Octopus Island. Real physics, responsive flippers, immersive lights and sound. Complete table missions, earn cash, and collect trophies and prizes. Take a break with darts, basketball, and more — and this universe keeps growing. Grab a machine, master every ball, and build your dream arcade!
